verdict.rationale: Canny hosts a customer-facing feedback site/Portal (canny-docs-7), and the basic install step is just adding a link to it (canny-docs-1), which suggests a hosted portal a PM could stand up without much code. However, tying feedback to user accounts requires installing a JavaScript SDK (canny-docs-2), and embedded widgets and SSO need developer install docs (canny-docs-17, canny-docs-19), so 'no engineering' holds only for a basic standalone portal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of no-code portal setup and branding by non-technical users, user identification without the SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of PM-only onboarding.
